pages.text: The Alloy Smelter is a machine used to smelt ores and create alloys. It can be upgraded with various upgrades to improve its performance.

pages.title: Alloy Smelter
pages.text: A multi-purpose smelting machine that can process ores and create advanced alloys like Steel.

The Alloy Smelter accepts upgrades to enhance its capabilities:$(br)• Capacity Upgrades: Increase energy storage$(br)• Temperature Upgrades: Increase max temperature$(br)• Efficiency Upgrades: Improve energy efficiency$(br2)Each upgrade type is available in Tier 2 and Tier 3 versions.
